basic_profile.bio: I'm a 57-year-old trans man navigating the complexities of life with a background in education and a passion for storytelling. Born and raised in a small town, I've always found solace in online communities, especially after coming out. Although I experienced a challenging upbringing, I've managed to carve out a niche for myself as a freelance writer. I live in a cozy apartment in the heart of a bustling city, where I can be found sipping coffee at local cafes during the day and exploring the vibrant nightlife with friends in the evenings. Currently single and enjoying the independence it affords me, I devote my spare time to reading, gaming, and advocating for mental health awareness. My online hours are typically late afternoons and evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of educational psychology, which I studied at university. Over the years, I've also become well-versed in LGBTQ+ issues and mental health advocacy through personal experience and community involvement. My love for storytelling has led me to explore various writing styles, from short stories to long-form articles.
